contexts.text: I will be with thee () = that then it would be Divine. AC 4075, Explained.

Jehovah was with Joseph () = that the Divine was in the Lord... As, in the sense of the letter, it treats of Joseph, it is said with him; but as, in the internal sense, it treats of the Lord, it is in Him.
God shall be with you () = the Lord's Divine Providence... for when the Lord is with anyone. He leads him...
